import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix sex label variants (strip whitespace)
    if df['sex'].dtype == 'object':
        df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    # Fix flipper_length_mm negatives (take absolute value)
    neg_mask = df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0
    df.loc[neg_mask, 'flipper_length_mm'] = df.loc[neg_mask, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out of range values (set to NaN)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
